---
title: "Labs"
---

Labs referenced by the Sandcastle course. Course-scoped labs live
under `courses/sandcastle/labs/`; reusable labs shared with other
courses live under the repository-root [`labs/`](../../../labs/index.html)
directory.

## Referenced labs

- **[Hello World Pico Sandcastle](../../../labs/hello-world-pico-sandcastle/)**
  — the first runnable Sandcastle lab. Runs a real Sandcastle
  end-to-end (isolated workspace, PATH allowlist, agent inner loop,
  artifact hand-off, sandbox teardown) to construct the
  `hello-world-pico` artifact on a dedicated
  `sandcastle/hello-world-pico` branch. Ships an automatable
  [`verify.sh`](../../../labs/hello-world-pico-sandcastle/downloads/verify.sh)
  and is exercised from Part 1's
  [Lab page](../part-1/01-inside-a-sandcastle/lab.qmd).
- **[Compose a Sandcastle request](../../../labs/compose-sandcastle-request/)**
  — the first runnable compose → construct lab. Takes a
  learner-authored Crossplane `XHelloWorldPico` XR, has a simulated
  Composition emit an `EngineeringTask`, and has a Sandcastle pick
  up the task and construct the requested `rules/hello.yaml` on a
  dedicated `sandcastle/hello-world-pico-<name>` branch. Ships an
  automatable
  [`verify.sh`](../../../labs/compose-sandcastle-request/downloads/verify.sh)
  and is exercised from Part 2's
  [Lab page](../part-2/01-composing-a-sandcastle-request/lab.qmd).
- **[Sandcastle → Kubernetes hand-off](../../../labs/handoff-sandcastle-to-kubernetes/)**
  — the first runnable Sandcastle-to-Crossplane hand-off lab. Takes
  the durable branch the Sandcastle lab produced and promotes its
  greeting `value` into a Crossplane `XHelloWorldPico` Composite
  Resource that drops into the
  [Hello Pico on Kubernetes lab](../../../labs/hello-pico-on-kubernetes/)
  without modification. Ships an automatable
  [`verify.sh`](../../../labs/handoff-sandcastle-to-kubernetes/downloads/verify.sh)
  and is exercised from Part 3's
  [Lab page](../part-3/01-handing-off-to-kubernetes/lab.qmd).
- **[Outer delivery loop](../../../labs/outer-delivery-loop/)** —
  the first runnable outer-loop lab. Takes the XR the hand-off lab
  produced, drives it through a real GitHub pull request and merge
  on a learner-controlled env repo, and reconciles the merged XR
  onto the Crossplane cluster from
  [Hello Pico on Kubernetes](../../../labs/hello-pico-on-kubernetes/)
  via Flux (with a `kubectl` fallback). Ships an automatable
  [`verify.sh`](../../../labs/outer-delivery-loop/downloads/verify.sh)
  that runs stages 1–2 against live GitHub without requiring a
  cluster, and is exercised from Part 3's
  [Lab page](../part-3/02-outer-delivery-loop/lab.qmd).

## Related reusable labs

These reusable labs give useful context — they define the
**artifact** the Sandcastle lab produces and the **cluster** the
hand-off lab targets:

- [Hello Pico](../../../labs/hello-pico/) — produces the
  `hello-world-pico` greeting artifact by hand from the
  [Pico course](../../pico/index.html). This is the same artifact
  the Sandcastle lab above constructs under an agent.
- [Hello Pico on Kubernetes](../../../labs/hello-pico-on-kubernetes/)
  — composes `hello-world-pico` onto a local minikube cluster with
  Crossplane. The hand-off lab above produces exactly the XR this
  lab consumes, so the two labs meet at a file-level contract.

## Authoring course-scoped labs

Course-scoped labs live in this directory and follow the shared lab
template. Reuse a repository-root lab when the same lab is useful for
more than one course.
